_meta.topic: RAG / Knowledge Retrieval frontier (first broad sweep)
_meta.notes: 3 parallel agents — multi-vector retrievers + RAG systems + RAG benchmarks. First broad RAG sweep — dashboard had limited coverage prior.

models.name: CRAG (Corrective RAG)
models.vendor: Yan et al. (Vector Institute / Squirrel AI)

benchmarks.name: ViDoRe v1 Average NDCG@5
benchmarks.description: 10 visual document retrieval tasks across domains (medical, business, scientific), modalities (text, figures, infographics, tables), languages (EN, FR)

benchmarks.name: ViDoRe v2 Average NDCG@5
benchmarks.description: Harder visual retrieval benchmark: ESG Reports, Insurance, Economics, Biomedical (manual + multilingual variants)

benchmarks.name: BEIR Average NDCG@10
benchmarks.description: Heterogeneous zero-shot IR benchmark (13-18 datasets depending on configuration)

benchmarks.name: MIRACL Multilingual Average NDCG@10
benchmarks.description: Multilingual retrieval, 17 languages

benchmarks.name: CLEF Average NDCG@10
benchmarks.description: Cross-Language Evaluation Forum multilingual retrieval

benchmarks.name: MTEB Retrieval Average

benchmarks.name: JMTEB Average
benchmarks.description: Japanese Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (5 tasks, 28 datasets)

benchmarks.name: RAGAS
benchmarks.description: Automated RAG evaluation: Faithfulness, Answer Relevancy, Context Precision/Recall. Es et al. 2023.

benchmarks.name: RGB (Retrieval-Augmented Generation Benchmark)
benchmarks.description: Tests noise robustness, negative rejection, info integration, counterfactual robustness.

benchmarks.name: CRAG (Comprehensive RAG Benchmark)
benchmarks.description: Meta KDD Cup 2024; 4,409 QA pairs across Finance/Sports/Music/Movies/Open.

benchmarks.name: NoLiMa
benchmarks.description: Long-context eval beyond literal matching (ICML 2025); removes lexical overlap cues.

benchmarks.name: LongBench-Cite
benchmarks.description: Long-context QA with sentence-level citations; correctness + citation F1.

benchmarks.name: ALCE
benchmarks.description: Auto-evaluation of LLM citation; ASQA, QAMPARI, ELI5.

benchmarks.name: MultiHop-RAG
benchmarks.description: Tang & Yang COLM 2024; 2,556 multi-hop queries on news corpus.

benchmarks.name: MS MARCO RAG subset
benchmarks.description: Passage ranking + QA subset commonly used in RAG eval.

benchmarks.name: FreshQA
benchmarks.description: Tests timeliness; questions with answers that change over time.

benchmarks.name: PopQA
benchmarks.description: Long-tail entity QA; 14k questions.

benchmarks.name: TriviaQA
benchmarks.description: Trivia questions with web evidence.

benchmarks.name: Natural Questions
benchmarks.description: Real Google queries with Wikipedia answers.

benchmarks.name: HotpotQA
benchmarks.description: Multi-hop QA over Wikipedia.

benchmarks.name: MuSiQue
benchmarks.description: Multi-hop questions via single-hop composition.

benchmarks.name: 2WikiMultiHopQA
benchmarks.description: 2-hop questions over Wikipedia.

benchmarks.name: NarrativeQA
benchmarks.description: Books/movie scripts QA; ROUGE-L metric.

benchmarks.name: QASPER
benchmarks.description: Full NLP paper QA; F1-Match.

benchmarks.name: QuALITY
benchmarks.description: Multi-choice QA on medium-length passages.

benchmarks.name: ARC-Challenge
benchmarks.description: AI2 Reasoning Challenge.

benchmarks.name: PubHealth
benchmarks.description: True/false health claims.

benchmarks.name: Biography (FactScore)
benchmarks.description: Long-form biography generation with FactScore.

benchmarks.name: PubMedQA
benchmarks.description: Biomedical research QA from PubMed abstracts.

benchmarks.name: MedMCQA
benchmarks.description: Indian medical entrance exam MCQs.

benchmarks.name: USMLE (MedQA)
benchmarks.description: US Medical Licensing Exam QA.

benchmarks.name: GraphRAG Podcast (Comprehensiveness + Diversity Win-Rate)
benchmarks.description: LLM-as-judge pairwise win-rate on Podcast transcript corpus.
